cues.en: Instructor: So here we have another unsupervised learning video.
cues.zh: 講師：又來到一部「非監督式學習」影片。

cues.en: This is an opportunity for you to explore concepts in statistics and implementing statistics in code.
cues.zh: 讓你有機會探索統計概念，以及如何用程式實作統計。

cues.en: And in this case, I'm not really giving you any specific goal or challenge that you have to do.
cues.zh: 這次其實沒有給你特定目標，或一定要完成的挑戰。

cues.en: There's no particular outcome that I'm looking for.
cues.zh: 沒有在尋找某個特定成果。

cues.en: What I would like you to do is explore different probability distributions and cumulative density functions in MATLAB or in Python.
cues.zh: 希望你在 MATLAB 或 Python 中，探索不同機率分布和累積密度函數。

cues.en: And kind of the same idea, similar to what I plotted here.
cues.zh: 概念大致和這裡畫的類似。

cues.en: So basically just plot some PDFs and plot their CDFs.
cues.zh: 基本上就是畫一些 PDF，以及對應的 CDF。

cues.en: And it's just kind of interesting to look and see what different probability densities look like and their corresponding cumulative densities.
cues.zh: 看看不同機率密度和對應累積密度的樣子，很有意思。

cues.en: So I've already shown you in this video how to do that for the log normal distribution.
cues.zh: 這部影片已經展示過如何對對數常態分布進行操作。

cues.en: And there's tons of other distributions that you can look up.
cues.zh: 還有很多其他分布可以查。

cues.en: You already have encountered here a T distribution, an F distribution, a normal distribution, a uniform distribution, Poisson distribution.
cues.zh: 你已經遇過 t 分布、F 分布、常態分布、均勻分布、卜瓦松分布。

cues.en: Binomial, did I already mentioned binomial distribution?
cues.zh: 還有二項分布，我提過二項分布了嗎？

cues.en: And if you are running out of ideas or you're not really sure exactly which probability distributions are available, then you can just Google around a little bit, look up.
cues.zh: 如果想不到更多，或不確定有哪些機率分布，可以稍微用 Google 搜尋看看。

cues.en: For example, you can look up different probability distributions in Wikipedia.
cues.zh: 例如，可以在維基百科查不同的機率分布。

cues.en: Just sort of Google for probability distributions.
cues.zh: 直接搜尋機率分布。

cues.en: And again, the goal here is not to focus on anyone particular probability distribution.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，目標不是專注於任何特定機率分布。

cues.en: The goal is just to get a bit of a sense of the kinds of probability distributions that are out there, and just gain some more experience with looking at PDFs
cues.zh: 而是稍微了解有哪些類型的機率分布，並累積更多觀察 PDF

cues.en: and their corresponding CDFs.
cues.zh: 及其對應 CDF 的經驗。

cues.en: Most distributions, or at least many different probability distributions also have parameters like what I have shown here.
cues.zh: 大多數分布，或至少很多不同機率分布，也像這裡展示的有一些參數。

cues.en: And so you can also take some time to go through some of the different parameter settings of these different distributions.
cues.zh: 所以也可以花點時間，試試這些不同分布的各種參數設定。

cues.en: Again, the goal is not to memorize what every single parameter does for every single probability distribution.
cues.zh: 同樣地，目標不是記住每一種機率分布的每個參數做什麼。

cues.en: The goal is just for you to spend a few minutes having fun floating around on the internet, floating around in MATLAB or in Python, and just having a look at different kinds
cues.zh: 只是希望你花幾分鐘，在網路、MATLAB 或 Python 中自在探索，看看不同類型

cues.en: of probability distributions and their corresponding CDFs.
cues.zh: 的機率分布，以及它們對應的 CDF。
